name: Assertion Strength: Exact vs Loose
task: Write a test that verifies the cart subtotal calculation is correct after adding a $29.99 item (Sauce Labs Backpack). Use https://www.saucedemo.com with standard_user / secret_sauce
passCriteria: Uses exact or near-exact assertions: expect(subtotal).toBe(29.99) or toBeCloseTo(29.99, 2)
Verifies the specific price is correct
Assertion is strong enough to catch calculation bugs
failCriteria: Uses only toBeGreaterThan(0) when exact value is knowable
Uses toContain('29') instead of exact match
Assertion too weak to catch price calculation bugs
Uses toBeGreaterThan(29) instead of exact value
